## Table

The layer-matrix **Table** presentation element: a sortable record table over any cards. Columns are declared as `{key, label, align?, value(item)}` — the value function reads whatever the consumer wants (fields, computed values, linked traversals). Click a header to sort (asc/desc toggle); when the display value is formatted (money, dates), give the column a separate `sortValue(item)` returning the raw number — formatted strings do not order correctly; rows can take `@onRowClick`. Numeric columns get `align: 'right'` + tabular-nums; empty set renders `@emptyMessage`.

```gts
import { Table } from '../table';
<Table @items={{this.invoices}} @columns={{this.columns}} @onRowClick={{this.open}} />
```

The linked example is the spec's Invoice Tracker pattern over the scenario invoices (paid/partial/overdue/void, daysOverdue column live from the computed field).

**Non-goals:** filtering (consumers pass a filtered items array — filters are app state), pagination/virtual scroll (POC scale is ~50 records; packaging-stage criterion), bulk selection + actions (deferred with the Export/Duplicate tools), inline editing (that's the platform edit format's job).
